title: MC C101: General
officialText:
C101.1 Scope.

The figures in this appendix shall supplement the provisions for venting of tanks in Section 1305 and are intended for illustrative purposes. Where there is a conflict between the figures in this appendix and the provisions in Section 1305, the provisions of Section 1305 shall govern.

Figure C101.1(1)Primary Tank: UL 80, ASME BPVC, or NYC Alternate TankDay Tank: UL 80, ASME BPVC, or NYC Alternate Tank

Figure C101.1(2)Primary Tank: UL 142 or Dual Label TankDay Tank: UL 142 or Dual Label Tank

Figure C101.1(3)Primary Tank: UL 80, ASME BPVC, or NYC Alternate TankDay Tank: UL 142 or Dual Label Tank
